stories.title: Phosphate rules blocking small planning applications in Flintshire
stories.summary: Small planning applications across Flintshire are being refused because of phosphate pollution rules protecting the River Dee. A councillor has told a scrutiny committee that the problem is affecting small businesses across the county. Officers warned the wider issue could take up to three years to resolve. stories.summary: A former Coleg Cambria student who was among the first through the doors of Deeside Sixth is now helping inspire the next generation to engage with politics, history and democracy through her work at Gladstone’s Library. stories.title: Flintshire parents urged to apply for September 2027 secondary school places
stories.summary: Parents of children in Year 6 across Flintshire can now apply for a secondary school place for September 2027, with applications open until 31 October for on-time consideration. stories.title: Police and Natural Resources Wales carry out joint patrol against illegal off-roading in Halkyn
stories.summary: Police and Natural Resources Wales carried out a joint patrol in the Halkyn area this week, targeting illegal off-roading on protected wildlife land. The patrol focused on Sites of Special Scientific Interest, land protected for its wildlife or geology, which have seen repeated illegal off-roading. stories.title: Wales’ PISA scores lowest in UK for third assessment running
stories.summary: Wales recorded the lowest scores of all four UK nations in reading, science and maths in the latest PISA international education rankings, published today.
